name: 16GB VRAM: Llama 3.1 8B Q8_0 decode tokens/sec
methodology: llama.cpp CUDA backend, batch size 1, 512 token prompt, 128 token output, Q8_0 quantization, 16GB VRAM (e.g., RTX 5080, RTX 5070 Ti)
notes: 16GB VRAM is the sweet spot for mainstream local inference. An 8B model at Q8_0 requires ~9GB, fitting comfortably. A 13B model at Q4_K_M requires ~8GB, also fitting. A 32B model at Q4_K_M requires ~18GB, which exceeds 16GB. 16GB is suitable for models up to ~16B at 4-bit or ~8B at 8-bit.
